---
title: "CDS ERA5 Table Diagnostic"
output: html_document
---

```{r check}
library(sparklyr)
library(dplyr)
library(dbplyr)

sc <- spark_connect(method = "databricks")

# GWSC product pipeline ERA5 source: era5-daily-data.silver_staging.era5_daily_nn
nn <- tbl(sc, in_catalog("era5-daily-data", "silver_staging", "era5_daily_nn"))

# Schema + columns
cols <- colnames(nn)
s <- nn %>% head(3) %>% collect()

# Sri Lanka bbox: lat 5.9-9.9N, lon 79.7-81.9E
# Check if lat/lon col names match
lk_bbox <- nn %>%
  filter(latitude >= 5.9, latitude <= 9.9, longitude >= 79.7, longitude <= 81.9) %>%
  mutate(yr = year(time)) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), n_pixels = n_distinct(longitude, latitude),
            min_yr = min(yr), max_yr = max(yr)) %>%
  collect()

results <- list(cols = cols, schema_sample = s, sri_lanka_bbox = lk_bbox)
saveRDS(results, "/Volumes/projects/gwsc_drought/drought_outputs/diag_cds_era5.rds")

cat("Columns:\n"); print(cols)
cat("\nSchema sample:\n"); print(s)
cat("\nSri Lanka bbox check:\n"); print(lk_bbox)

spark_disconnect(sc)
```
